name: saiyan-status
description: Dragon Ball Z status line: transformation tier from Ki (context), Stamina, Zeni and Senzu Bean compaction.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the tier, Ki, Stamina and Zeni line under the prompt.

transformToasts.title: Transformation toasts
transformToasts.description: Toast when Ki (context fill) crosses into a new tier, up or down.

senzu.title: Senzu Bean
senzu.description: The /senzu command (compacts the conversation) and the 'Senzu Bean is ready' toast at Ki 85%.

autoSenzu.title: Auto Senzu
autoSenzu.description: Compact automatically once Ki reaches 92%, between turns.

staminaWarnings.title: Stamina warnings
staminaWarnings.description: Toast when the 5-hour rate-limit window crosses 80% and 90% (off by default: the scouter mod owns this toast).
